name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist role in Denver. Before my SaaS career I co-owned a state-licensed retail business here, so I know what a store owner's week looks like: compliance on one side, vendors and suppliers on the other, and no time for a system that isn't working on day one.

At Wix I onboarded 25+ small businesses a month, with about 25 in flight at once, at 110% of implementation targets, including e-commerce launches for brick-and-mortar retailers. I aimed to launch each customer on the first call and planned multi-session builds for the complex ones so go-live never slipped. At Birdeye I led onboarding and training for a partner network and kept all but one. Your line about customers never having to chase an update is how I run every implementation.
I'm local to Denver and comfortable with travel, evenings, and weekends when an install needs it. I'd welcome a conversation.
